Title: Question on What Stays and What Goes

Messages.Author: ramst...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
After the postings of What Stays and What Goes, the following situation
arose that again asked the question.

Player A plays Bloodhunt on one of Player B's minions.

Player A is ousted.

Does the Bloodhunt stay or go? Based upon the data posted, it is all
based upon who is the controller of the card. Bloodhunt once played is
not removable, either by (D) action or vote. So who controls the
card? The person who played the card? The person who owns the minion
to whom the Bloodhunt is on? Or is it now a table wide effect that
stays until the end of the game?

Thanks

Michael Eichler

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 7 Mar 2000 ramst...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Does the Bloodhunt stay or go? Based upon the data posted, it is all
> based upon who is the controller of the card. Bloodhunt once played is
> not removable, either by (D) action or vote. So who controls the
> card? The person who played the card?

All minion (i.e. non-master) cards are controlled by the player upon whose
minion the card resides. In this case, the Blood Hunt card would not go
until the player controlling the minion with it on was ousted. (i.e. it
pretty much can't be got rid of until you get rid of the vampire, or the
player)

--

James Coupe
